messages.reasoning_content: No img samples in hydration tests. Need to understand what the change is: the issue #12333 is presumably about hydration mismatch for `` attribute — during hydration, `` triggers a network request? Actually I recall a Svelte PR "fix: preserve existing src during hydration" — during hydration, `` was removed/reset causing duplicate requests. Real Svelte PR #12349? The change: hydration of `src` on img elements should not be overwritten... Let me check how attributes are set in client hydration. Look at template.js set_attribute / hydration handling.
